title: Request-echo prober pipeline: safe forking, tenant-aware sampling, and cost throttles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a request-echo (prober) pipeline that safely forks live production traffic into a sandboxed inference path for model validation, A/B analysis, and canary health checks. Goals: allow broad signal collection with bounded cost and no side effects to customers; provide tenant-aware sampling and per-tenant cost caps; maintain isolation so sandboxed requests never hit downstream stateful services; expose divergence/quality metrics to trigger auto-rollback or reduce sampling when thresholds breach.
acceptance_criteria: Echoed requests run through a sandbox runtime that has no write-side effects (db/notifications/3rd-party calls blocked)
Per-tenant sampling configuration is available via Console and respects rate limits and monthly token caps
Echoed traffic is tagged non-billable and visible in observability (per-model/per-tenant metrics)
Automatic throttling reduces sampling for tenants where token burn or divergence budget is exceeded
Canary health evaluator produces alerts and a single boolean rollback recommendation API
End-to-end tests simulate skewed models and validate auto-rollback path before release
tasks: Design: finalize sandbox routing semantics and scrubbing rules (headers, PII, side-effect suppression)
Infra: implement async forking using replicate-topic in Kafka with per-tenant partitioning
Runtime: add 'echo-mode' runtime flag to enforce non-stateful exec and token caps
Console: UI for per-tenant sampling config, monthly cap, and current spend burn-down
Observability: add Prometheus metrics & Grafana dashboards for echo-rate, divergence-rate, token-burn
Safety: implement a soft-fail fallback that stops forking if sandbox saturates or errors spike
comments: 2026-03-02 - AP: Kickoff meeting notes: prefer asynchronous fanout to avoid impact on p99 request paths. Agreed to scrub Authorization/Set-Cookie/Idempotency headers before echoing.

2026-03-04 - LM: PoC of replicate-topic created. Using per-tenant keying to enable independent sampling. Early finding: KV cache warmup on sandbox instances increases token spend for short-lived tenants.

2026-03-06 - AP: Trade-off captured: synchronous mirroring gives better determinism for latency-sensitive comparisons but risks head-of-line blocking. We will proceed with async plus a small 'fast-path' probe for high-frequency tenants later.
2026-03-08 - Security review request posted (confluence link attached). Noted requirement: sandbox must never have network egress to customer integrations. Using internal allowlist only.
2026-03-09 - LM: Integration test failing intermittently due to consumer lag when sampling spikes. Added token-based rate limiter to the replicate consumer as mitigation.
notes: Key design decisions: (1) Echo path will be non-billable by default and billed experiments will require an explicit opt-in, (2) Sampling config supports deterministic hashing by tenant+model to make A/B comparisons reproducible, (3) Sandbox instances will run on separate GPU pools with lower priority and an enforced token cap per tenant.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: uncontrolled sampling could spike costs and warm up KV caches, distorting production metrics. Mitigation: per-tenant monthly caps, sliding-window token burn throttles, and automatic reduction of sampling on high divergence or cost burn.
